subject: Latest version of R on Windows 7

messages.author: 94c3c0e012bc40b8
messages.subject: Latest version of R on Windows 7
parts: How can one get the latest version of R (currently 3.0.2) with a Windows machine?  The default version appears to be 2.15.3.  In the Admin. Guide (http://rstudio.github.io/shiny-server/latest/#installation) the instructions appear to be Linux based for this action.  Is it possible to use the latest version of R with Shiny on a Windows machine?  If so how?

messages.author: 5712068fdf482d27
messages.subject: Re: Latest version of R on Windows 7
parts:
I think you meant to install the desktop server of Shiny. The instruction you saw is for server Shiny. To run shiny you just need to install Rstudio desktop (http://www.rstudio.com/ide/download/desktop) and install R v3.0.2 (http://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/). 

In the R console type install.packages("shiny") then you will have Shiny installed.

There's getting started with Shiny section in 

http://www.rstudio.com/shiny/

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Latest version of R on Windows 7
parts:
Tyler,

There is no Shiny Server for Windows at this time; the software is currently only compatible with Linux (although some brave souls have gotten it working on Mac as well). In the future we may offer a native Windows version of Shiny Server.

We also have a new Shiny hosting service in beta that will replace Glimmer and Spark (which can't easily be upgraded to R 3.0.2 without breaking existing users' code), that service is called ShinyApps and is already on the latest version of R. It has a very different architecture from Glimmer/Spark that will prevent some of the problems that we have had with those servers.
